notes: The KPI Staking allocation tracks MEGA tokens claimed from the staking contract. These tokens are distributed after completing KPIs
The Mainnet Campaign was originally allocated 2.5% of the total supply but it was cancelled.
Public sale participants can choose between 100% unlocked at TGE or a 1-year lock with potential discounts, we have modeled it as fully unlocked at TGE  for simplicity.

KPI Staking.methodology: 53% of total supply allocated to the KPI staking contract. Stakers receive MEGA rewards when chain KPIs are completed.

kpi-staking-rewards.name: KPI Staking
kpi-staking-rewards.methodology: Tracks RewardsClaimed events from the MegaStaking contract on MegaETH. Stakers earn MEGA when chain KPIs are achieved.

Incentives.methodology: Tracks MEGA token distributions through Merkl DistributionCreator campaigns

merkl-campaigns.name: Merkl Campaigns
merkl-campaigns.methodology: Tracks NewCampaign events from Merkl DistributionCreator. Campaign amounts are amortized evenly across their duration.
